an1.11:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yena anuppanno vā kāmacchando uppajjati, uppanno vā kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave subhanimittaṃ.
an1.11:1.2: subhanimittaṃ bhikkhave ayoniso manasi karoto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando uppajjati, uppanno ca kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatī.
an1.12:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yena anuppanno vā vyāpādo uppajjati, uppanno vā vyāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave paṭighanimittaṃ.
an1.12:1.2: paṭighanimittaṃ bhikkhave ayoniso manasi karoto anuppanno ceva vyāpādo uppajjati, uppanno ca vyāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatīti.
an1.13:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yena anuppannaṃ vā thinamiddhaṃ uppajjati, uppannaṃ vā thinamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave arati tandī vijambhikā bhattasammado cetaso ca līnattaṃ.
an1.13:1.2: līnacittassa bhikkhave anuppannaṃ ceva thinamiddhaṃ uppajjati, uppannañca thinamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatīti.
an1.14:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yena anuppannaṃ vā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati, uppannaṃ vā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave cetaso avūpasamo.
an1.14:1.2: avūpasantacittassa bhikkhave anuppannaṃ ceva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati, uppannaṃ ca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatīti.
an1.15:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yena anuppannā vā vicikicchā uppajjati, uppannā vā vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave ayoniso manasikāro.
an1.15:1.2: ayoniso bhikkhave manasi karoto anuppannā ceva vicikicchā uppajjati, uppannā ca vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatīti.
an1.16:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yena anuppanno vā kāmacchando nuppajjati, uppanno vā kāmacchando pahīyati, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave asubhanimittaṃ.
an1.16:1.2: asubhanimittaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasi karoto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando nuppajjati uppanno ca kāmacchando pahīyatīti.
an1.17:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yena anuppanno vā vyāpādo nuppajjati, uppanno vā vyāpādo pahīyati, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave mettā cetovimutti.
an1.17:1.2: mettaṃ bhikkhave cetovimuttiṃ yoniso manasi karoto anuppanno ceva vyāpādo nuppajjati, uppanno ca vyāpādo pahīyatīti.
an1.18:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yena anuppannaṃ vā thinamiddhaṃ nuppajjati, uppannaṃ vā thinamiddhaṃ pahīyati, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave ārambhadhātu nikkamadhātu parakkamadhātu.
an1.18:1.2: āraddhaviriyassa bhikkhave anuppannañceva thinamiddhaṃ nuppajjati, uppannañca thinamiddhaṃ pahīyatīti.
an1.19:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yena anuppannaṃ vā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ nuppajjati, uppannaṃ vā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīyati, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave cetaso vūpasamo.
an1.19:1.2: vūpasantacittassa bhikkhave anuppannaṃ ceva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ nuppajjati, uppannañca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīyatīti.
an1.20:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yena anuppannā vā vicikicchā nuppajjati, uppannā vā vicikicchā pahīyati, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikāro.
an1.20:1.2: yoniso bhikkhave manasi karoto anuppannā ceva vicikicchā nuppajjati, uppannā ca vicikicchā pahīyatīti.
